items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Carroll Dickerson having a band and Pops (Louis Armstrong) working with him. The interviewee (Joe Thomas) does not claim to have worked with, met, or been influenced by Carroll Dickerson, only responding to the interviewer's narrative about Dickerson's band.

ctx.x: Oh, as late as that? You didn't hear him come in with Frank Malinborn?
Oh, no. Had to be St. Louis. In fact, see Carroll Dickerson had a band out of Chicago.
